project_type: Full-stack: Go backend + React SPA/SSR frontend (React Router v7, Vite, TailwindCSS v4)
build_system: pnpm for frontend, Go modules + Makefile for backend. Build command: make check (runs go test + pnpm typecheck + pnpm lint)
test_framework: No frontend unit tests. Go tests via go test. Frontend validation via typecheck and lint.
verification_instructions: Run pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint in web/ directory to validate TypeScript and lint correctness.
environment_constraints: Network may be limited. pnpm store already exists at /projects/sandbox/.pnpm-store. node_modules already installed.
contribution_requirements: Use t() for all user-visible text. Add i18n keys to both zh-CN.ts and en-US.ts. Follow existing patterns in the codebase.
key_patterns: Components in web/components/layout/. i18n messages in web/lib/i18n/messages/{zh-CN,en-US}.ts. useCurrentUser() from @/components/app/app-provider. useAppConfig() for siteNavs. usePathname() from @/lib/router/navigation. cn() for classnames. buttonVariants() for nav link styling. DropdownMenu from @/components/ui/dropdown-menu. SiteNav type has: title, url, openInNewWindow?, children?. Module items pattern in web/components/layout/module-items.ts.
directory_structure: web/ - frontend app. web/app/routes/ - route files. web/components/ - shared components. web/components/layout/ - layout components (header, nav, aside). web/lib/ - utilities, api, i18n. internal/ - Go backend.
